title: Garden with Herbs
preview: Pause among the herbs of the island. Thyme, oregano, mint, marjoram and lavender connect the kitchen, the home remedy and the memory of family life in Kefalos.
details: Before supermarkets and modern pharmacies were part of daily life, a small garden could be both kitchen and medicine cabinet. Herbs gave flavor to food, comfort to the body and scent to the home.

At Mylotopi, these plants help visitors understand the practical wisdom of island families. A few leaves could season bread, meat or vegetables; the same garden could offer a simple infusion for a difficult day.
Notice the muted greens, silver leaves and purple lavender. The beauty of this stop is quiet, but it belongs deeply to the rhythm of the old village.
Continue toward the historic windmill, where the story moves from garden and family care to wheat, flour and hard physical work.
